bluetooth_confirm.description: Add clock {name} ({address})? Time will be synced daily and at Home Assistant start.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a LYWSD02

init.title: Time sync
init.description: Daily check: the clock is read and the time is written only if it drifted more than the threshold. If the clock advertises no temperature/humidity for the given time, they are read over a Bluetooth connection.

data.fallback_after: Read over Bluetooth if no readings for, s

sync_all.name: Sync all clocks
sync_all.description: Write the current time to all LYWSD02 clocks.

force.name: Force
force.description: Write the time even if the drift is within the threshold.

identify_all.name: Show numbers on all clocks
identify_all.description: Each clock shows its own number (01:11, 02:22, ...) and °F for a minute, so you can tell which is which. The mapping appears in notifications.

read_sensors.name: Read sensors now
read_sensors.description: Connect to every clock and read temperature, humidity and battery directly (normally they come from advertisements).
